-- Insert 5 basic operational workflow templates with their stages
-- Uses UUID for IDs and two-table structure (workflow_templates + template_stages)

-- Get current user ID (assuming eddie.amintohir@compawnion.co)
SET @creator_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'eddie.amintohir@compawnion.co' LIMIT 1);

-- ========================================
-- 1. Purchase Request (PR) Template
-- ========================================
SET @pr_template_id = UUID();
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (id, name, description, workflow_type, is_active, is_default, is_quick_assign_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  @pr_template_id,
  'Purchase Request (PR)',
  'Standard purchase request form for procuring goods or services from external vendors',
  'PR',
  TRUE,
  FALSE,
  TRUE,
  @creator_id,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- PR Template Stages
INSERT INTO template_stages (id, template_id, stage_order, stage_name, stage_description, department, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES
  (UUID(), @pr_template_id, 1, 'Department Head Review', 'Department head reviews and approves the purchase request', NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @pr_template_id, 2, 'Purchasing Review', 'Purchasing team reviews vendor selection and pricing', 'Purchasing', NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @pr_template_id, 3, 'Finance Review', 'Finance team reviews budget availability', 'Finance', NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @pr_template_id, 4, 'CFO Approval', 'CFO provides final approval for purchase', 'CFO', NOW(), NOW());

-- ========================================
-- 2. Material Authorization Form (MAF) Template
-- ========================================
SET @maf_template_id = UUID();
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (id, name, description, workflow_type, is_active, is_default, is_quick_assign_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  @maf_template_id,
  'Material Authorization Form (MAF)',
  'Authorization form for material usage, inventory withdrawal, or resource allocation',
  'MAF',
  TRUE,
  FALSE,
  TRUE,
  @creator_id,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- MAF Template Stages
INSERT INTO template_stages (id, template_id, stage_order, stage_name, stage_description, department, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES
  (UUID(), @maf_template_id, 1, 'Department Head Review', 'Department head reviews material request justification', NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @maf_template_id, 2, 'PPIC Review', 'PPIC verifies inventory availability and production schedule', 'PPIC', NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @maf_template_id, 3, 'Finance Review', 'Finance reviews cost implications', 'Finance', NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @maf_template_id, 4, 'CFO Approval', 'CFO provides final authorization', 'CFO', NOW(), NOW());

-- ========================================
-- 3. Budget Request Template
-- ========================================
SET @budget_template_id = UUID();
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (id, name, description, workflow_type, is_active, is_default, is_quick_assign_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  @budget_template_id,
  'Budget Request',
  'Request for budget allocation for projects, campaigns, or departmental expenses',
  'Budget',
  TRUE,
  FALSE,
  TRUE,
  @creator_id,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- Budget Template Stages
INSERT INTO template_stages (id, template_id, stage_order, stage_name, stage_description, department, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES
  (UUID(), @budget_template_id, 1, 'Department Head Review', 'Department head reviews budget justification and ROI', NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @budget_template_id, 2, 'Finance Review', 'Finance team reviews budget availability and financial impact', 'Finance', NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @budget_template_id, 3, 'CFO Approval', 'CFO approves budget allocation', 'CFO', NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @budget_template_id, 4, 'CEO Final Approval', 'CEO provides final approval for large budget requests', 'CEO', NOW(), NOW());

-- ========================================
-- 4. Leave Request Template
-- ========================================
SET @leave_template_id = UUID();
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (id, name, description, workflow_type, is_active, is_default, is_quick_assign_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  @leave_template_id,
  'Leave Request',
  'Employee leave application for vacation, sick leave, or personal time off',
  'Leave',
  TRUE,
  FALSE,
  TRUE,
  @creator_id,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- Leave Template Stages
INSERT INTO template_stages (id, template_id, stage_order, stage_name, stage_description, department, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES
  (UUID(), @leave_template_id, 1, 'Department Head Review', 'Department head reviews leave request and team coverage', NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @leave_template_id, 2, 'GA Approval', 'GA verifies leave balance and company policy compliance', 'GA', NOW(), NOW());

-- ========================================
-- 5. Expense Reimbursement Template
-- ========================================
SET @expense_template_id = UUID();
INSERT INTO workflow_templates (id, name, description, workflow_type, is_active, is_default, is_quick_assign_enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  @expense_template_id,
  'Expense Reimbursement',
  'Claim reimbursement for business-related expenses (travel, meals, supplies, etc.)',
  'Expense',
  TRUE,
  FALSE,
  TRUE,
  @creator_id,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- Expense Template Stages
INSERT INTO template_stages (id, template_id, stage_order, stage_name, stage_description, department, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES
  (UUID(), @expense_template_id, 1, 'Department Head Review', 'Department head verifies expense legitimacy and business purpose', NULL, NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @expense_template_id, 2, 'Finance Review', 'Finance reviews receipts and calculates reimbursement amount', 'Finance', NOW(), NOW()),
  (UUID(), @expense_template_id, 3, 'CFO Approval', 'CFO approves reimbursement payment', 'CFO', NOW(), NOW());
